title: data.pdf — section 176
text:
(3) In section 3 (punishment for disobedience to witness summons) after subsection (1)
there shall be inserted—
“(1A) Any person who without just excuse disobeys a requirement made by any
court under section 2A above shall be guilty of contempt of that court and may
be punished summarily by that court as if his contempt had been committed
in the face of the court.”

(4) In section 3, in subsection (2) for the words “such disobedience” there shall be
substituted “any disobedience mentioned in subsection (1) or (1A) above”.

(5) In section 4 (further process to secure attendance of witness) in the proviso to
subsection (1) after the word “give” there shall be inserted “evidence likely to be”.

(6) Schedule 1 (application for direction that witness summons shall be of no effect) shall
be omitted.
